main.description: A member's profile within a community. Lives in the community's `members` space, authored and keyed by the member's own DID. Members configure this themselves; it may be seeded from login-provider account metadata (e.g. Google name/picture) on first join.

displayName.description: The member's display name within the community.

bio.description: A short bio for the member.

avatarUrl.description: URL of the member's avatar image.
